mount_options.description: List of FUSE and ceph-fuse mount options (e.g., ['allow_other', 'big_writes', 'client_mountpoint=/some/path']). Each item is passed as a separate argument.

mon_addr.description: Monitor address:port (e.g., '10.0.0.1:6789') to bypass ceph.conf lookup.

client_id.description: Client ID (e.g., 'admin') — used with -n client.ID. Must be a valid CephX username component.

keyring_path.description: Explicit path to client keyring file.

root_directory.description: Root directory within CephFS to mount (instead of full Ceph tree).

fs_name.description: Name of the CephFS to mount (if not using the default).

foreground.description: If true, run in foreground (no daemonization, no pidfile).

debug.description: If true, enable FUSE debugging output to stderr.

pidfile_path.description: Path to pidfile to write when running in background (ignored if foreground=true).
